verdicts.title: Twisted iterated algebraic K-theory and topological T-duality for sphere bundles
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: We introduce a periodic form of the iterated algebraic K-theory of ku, the (connective) complex K-theory spectrum, as well as a natural twisting of this cohomology theory by higher gerbes. Furthermore, we prove a form of topological T-duality for sphere bundles oriented with respect to this theory.

It shares only the vocabulary 'algebraic K-theory' with the conjecture.

verdicts.title: Algebraic v. topological K-theory: a friendly match
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: These notes evolved from the lecture notes of a minicourse given in Swisk, the Sedano Winter School on K-theory held in Sedano, Spain, during the week January 22--27 of 2007, and from those of a longer course given in the University of Buenos Aires, during the second half of 2006. They intend to be an introduction to $K$-theory, with emphasis in the comparison between its algebraic and topological variants. We have tried to keep as elementary as possible.

verdicts.title: The plethory of operations in complex topological K-theory
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: We provide a concrete introduction to the topologised, graded analogue of an algebraic structure known as a plethory, originally due to Tall and Wraith. Stacey and Whitehouse showed this structure is present on the cohomology operations for a suitable generalised cohomology theory. We compute an explicit expression for the plethory of operations for complex topological K-theory.
